scope: xcrypto 1.2.8-sora.2 native source remediation, not a claim that every wallet/native path is vulnerability-free

remediations.reachability: Schnorrkel 0.9.1 native derivation/signing uses the scalar math; version match and affected source confirmed, no exploit demonstrated
remediations.action: Backport original volatile underflow-mask barrier in both u64 and u32 scalar subtraction backends; no mathematical/API change
remediations.scope: Original upstream security patches #659/#661 only; subsequent #662 refactoring is not claimed

remediations.reachability: Internal logging feature was not enabled in JNI dependency graph. Still backported no-op logging to prevent reentrant custom logger callbacks for future feature-enabled consumers
remediations.action: Remove optional log dependency and make log feature inert; compile all internal log macros to no-ops without changing RNG behavior

remediations.reachability: Unused direct JNI proc-macro declaration; actual Schnorrkel derive uses 1.4.2
remediations.action: Remove unused direct dependency and its obsolete six-package closure; retain required zeroize_derive 1.4.2
